blocks.title: Graph
blocks.text: A graph is a set of vertices (nodes) connected by edges, used to represent networks of connections. Vertices can be cities, people or ideas; edges are the relationships or pathways between them.

Mapping the cities of Pakistan and the roads joining them gives a graph: each city is a vertex and each road an edge. In a social network each person can connect to many others. A tree is a special kind of graph: a tree has a single root and exactly one path between any two nodes, so no cycles, while a graph need not have a root and may have several paths and cycles. Trees suit structured data such as family trees; graphs suit networks, web links and transport systems.
